title: Notebook Storage Alerts
description: Get a warning when your notebook storage reaches the usage level you choose. Alerts do not delete files or add storage.

enabled.title: Show storage warnings
enabled.description: Check storage while JupyterLab is open. Turn this off to stop checks and clear the current warning; your files are not changed.

warningThreshold.title: Warn when storage usage reaches (%)
warningThreshold.description: Choose a value from 1 to 100. The default, 90, warns when 90% of usable space is used (about 10% remains). Choose a lower value for an earlier warning.

pollInterval.title: Check storage every (seconds)
pollInterval.description: Enter a whole number from 10 to 86400. The default, 60, checks about once a minute. Shorter intervals check more often; they do not free up space.
